question: Does the three-state ancestry contract currently fail in production, and if so at what rate, on each venue?

sampling.command: gh pr list --state all --limit 60 --json number,headRefOid | for each head: GET /repos/Archright/Axiom/commits/{sha}/check-runs, filter app.id==5795152
sampling.denominatorDefinition: the 60 most recently updated pull requests in any state; not a merge-queue cohort

sampling.command: git log --first-parent --merges -40 --format=%H origin/main | for each sha: GET /repos/Archright/Axiom/commits/{sha}/check-runs, filter app.id==5795152
sampling.denominatorDefinition: the 40 most recent first-parent merge commits on main, minus 2 that carry no check-run from app 5795152

interpretation.claim: In the sampled window no admission-check verdict on either venue carried a CANDIDATE_* reason code.
notClaimed: That the 8x64 deepen loop is correct. The sample shows it is not currently load-bearing, not that it is sound.
That the callee job logs were scanned. Callee job log retrieval returned no bytes for the sampled run, so the scan surface was the App-issued check-run summary only.
That the two venues share a denominator. The PR sample and the merge-group sample are different populations and are never pooled.

landingGate.mechanism: Any change to the verifier changes paths listed in config/policy/trust_surface_manifest.json, and the manifest requires those paths to be byte-identical between the evaluation commit and its base. A verifier upgrade is therefore self-authorizing by construction and is denied.
landingGate.documentedLane: docs/evidence/breakglass_trust_surface_landing_2026-11-19.md (audited break-glass, MUST-T2a delegation record pre-registered as a PR comment, temporary ruleset bypass on both required-check rulesets, REST merge, immediate restore)
landingGate.laneTakenReason: The measured failure rate is zero on both venues, so the governance cost of opening a bypass window is not currently justified. The ruleset remains frozen and bypass_actors remains empty.

pinChainAtObservation.note: The two uses pins are commit SHAs; trusted_writer_set and epoch_manifest hold the blob SHA of the verifier inside that commit. Coherence is the composition of both equalities, not equality between the commit SHA and the blob SHA.
pinChainAtObservation.candidateHeadBlobNote: the blob proposed by PR #333; it is not the current production blob
